resolvedDocumentaryFinding.originalProblem: An unqualified claim that diagnostic publication cannot affect close could be read as isolation of arbitrary subscriber errors. Node diagnostics_channel does not provide that guarantee.
resolvedDocumentaryFinding.authorisedCorrection: Root explicitly authorized this one precision. The document now limits the obligation to producer-owned validation/publication failures and requires a future TEST collector to contain its own callback errors. It explicitly excludes process exception handlers, channel wrappers and universal observer isolation.
resolvedDocumentaryFinding.inverseProof: The sole phrase replacement and added paragraph reverse exactly to the held 73-line original document; all other plan bytes preserved.

primarySources.claim: Subscriber callbacks are invoked synchronously; a throwing callback causes uncaughtException. No runtime experiment was performed.

primarySources.readScope: Relevant publish implementation, lines 161–174; complete bytes saved and compared to the retrieved source.
primarySources.claim: publish invokes onMessage(data, this.name) synchronously; its catch schedules triggerUncaughtException through process.nextTick. A publisher-level try/catch cannot contain that scheduled exception.

resolvedDocumentaryFinding.timingLimit: The selected channel retains synchronous subscriber work. Source-owned best-effort handling is not a latency bound or general isolation of arbitrary consumers.
